name: keyline
description: Design engine for AI agents: images at every size, no Chrome, 2× fewer tokens.
long_description: keyline is a design engine Claude drives over MCP. Claude builds a scene of text, images, shapes and layout; keyline measures it (text that doesn't fit, layers cut off, low contrast), so Claude fixes problems before rendering, and renders it as images or video at every size you ask for. No Chrome or browser needed: one native binary.

folders.title: Folders keyline works in
folders.description: Each design gets a folder in the first one, holding its scene and renders; Claude can add images and video from any of them by path. None: ~/keyline.

stills_only.title: Stills only
stills_only.description: Leave animation and video out of the tools: fewer tokens per message.
